name: Payment Origin 1 Choice
definition: Specifies the format under which the payment that generated the entry was transmitted.

FINMessageType.name: FIN Message Type
FINMessageType.definition: Specifies that the payment was included in a SWIFT FIN format message, for example, MT 103.

XMLMessageName.name: XML Message Name
XMLMessageName.definition: Specifies that the payment was included in a SWIFT XML message.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Specifies that the payment was included in a proprietary format message.

Instrument.name: Instrument
Instrument.definition: Specifies the type of payment when not included in a SWIFT or proprietary format.
